title: SAL Facts Database Schema
description: Schema for sal-facts-latest.json and sal-facts-*.json databases produced by the Specification Authority Layer. NOTE: The 'qname' field in spec_facts contains FACT-FORMAT-NNN canonical IDs (e.g. 'FACT-FODS-001'), NOT namespace:element QNames. This is a historical naming quirk — the field acts as fact_id.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this database was generated.

generator.description: Name and version of the tool that generated this file.

formats_processed.description: Number of format entries in results.

spec_facts_total.description: Total spec_facts across all format results.

workbench_verified_fact_total.description: Number of facts that have been workbench-verified.

spec_facts.description: Extracted specification facts for this format.

qname.description: Canonical fact identifier (e.g. 'FACT-FODS-001'). NOTE: Despite the name 'qname', this field contains FACT-IDs, not namespace:element QNames. Historical naming quirk from SAL pipeline.

claim.description: The specification claim or fact statement.

section.description: Section reference in the specification document.

fact_status.description: Current status of the fact in the pipeline.

authority_class.description: Authority classification. AI_DRAFT requires promotion before use in product decisions.
